new_hypothesis.name: pumpfun_graduation_snipe_via_pumpportal_ws
new_hypothesis.mechanism: Pump.fun tokens graduate to PumpSwap/Raydium when their bonding-curve market cap crosses ~$69k. At the moment of graduation, the token's liquidity transitions from a constant-product bonding curve (heavily front-loaded for the first ~50 buyers) to a true AMM pool. Three things happen in the next 5-30 minutes: (a) bonding-curve early buyers and ruggers exit aggressively (their cost basis is pennies; the AMM is exit liquidity); (b) DexScreener / Birdeye / Jupiter indexers ingest the new pair after a 30-90s lag, opening retail discovery; (c) FOMO inflow from new buyers who could not previously access the token via Jupiter/Phantom drives a 5-30 minute pump window before either momentum exhausts or the rug fires. Bots that wait for DexScreener to surface the pair miss the early window. PumpPortal WS pushes the graduation event sub-second, allowing entry inside the early-discovery window before retail liquidity arrives.
new_hypothesis.persistence: Three structural durability layers. (1) MECHANIC: pump.fun's bonding-curve-to-AMM transition is a permanent platform feature. As long as pump.fun exists and routes graduations to PumpSwap/Raydium, the discovery-lag-window persists. (2) RETAIL DELAY: DexScreener / Birdeye / aggregator indexer lag is fundamental to their architecture (they poll on-chain state, often via free RPC, with 30-90s cycles); PumpPortal WS is push-based and has no equivalent in the retail tooling stack. The latency edge is structural, not arbitraged. (3) COMPETITION SHAPE: institutional MEV bots target jito-bundle-cobuyer patterns (different signal); retail snipers buy from DexScreener (slower); PumpPortal WS sits between, accessible to anyone but currently unused by our bot. As long as PumpPortal stays free for pump.fun events (their fee model is post-graduation PumpSwap data at 0.01 SOL/10k trades, NOT graduation events), this is sustainable.
new_hypothesis.entry_rules: Phase 1 LOG-ONLY (~30-60 LOC): spawn a websocket-subscriber thread in degen_bot.py main loop. Subscribe to wss://pumpportal.fun/api/data with subscribeNewToken/subscribeMigration message (PumpPortal docs). On each graduation event, log to sol_pumpfun_graduation_log.json (ring buffer 500, atomic write): {ts, mint, symbol, market_cap_at_grad, creator, sol_in_pool_at_grad, time_since_creation_min, pumpportal_event_type}. Phase 2 (after N>=20 graduation events with forward-return data via separate trade-log mining): if forward 5/15/30-minute returns are positive >=60% of the time, promote to a new strategy 'pumpfun_grad_snipe' that triggers BUY within 60 seconds of graduation IF: (a) RugCheck token report passes (existing security gate), (b) sol_in_pool >= 30 SOL (~$2.5k floor), (c) creator does not appear in trade-log as a prior loss-creator. Phase 3: tune thresholds. Caveat: must dedupe with existing wallet_convergence / fresh_profile strategies (a graduation-snipe should NOT also fire if a target wallet just bought the same token).
new_hypothesis.data_required: ZERO new external paid APIs. Single free websocket: wss://pumpportal.fun/api/data. Subscribe message format documented at pumpportal.fun. Existing ALCHEMY_SOLANA_RPC remains mandatory for ANY supplementary RPC calls (per research-112 root-cause; do not use api.mainnet-beta.solana.com). New file: sol_pumpfun_graduation_log.json (ring buffer 500). Optional cross-link: at sell-time, look up whether the bought token came from a graduation event for forward-return analysis.
